correctness.rationale: All distances follow from three exact BFS rows of P(10,2) and rotational symmetry. The exhaustive 16-case equidistance table plus dihedral actions proves each of the 190 equalizers is empty or exactly two antipodal pairs; seven orbit witnesses prove every choice of two classes appears. These two facts yield necessary and sufficient resolution by at least three occupied classes. Counting each occupied pair as 2z+z^2 proves the complete polynomial and 960 minimum bases. Attached standalone standard-library verifier checks all distance rows, all 190 equalizers, all 45 possible class pairs, 6196 direct profiles and each of 1,048,576 subsets. No unproved infinite inference or external certificate is used.

value.rationale: The natural classical dodecahedral graph is the Platonic cubic graph GP(10,2). Full ordinary resolving-set classification and all-by-size polynomial of landmark placements are mathematically meaningful beyond the already known minimum of three, giving exact reliability for random independent sensor selection and specifying every optimal triple. The short antipodal equalizer proof exposes intrinsic distance structure, not an arbitrary slice or mere implementation.
